scientific_limitations_and_integrity: The theorem proves individual, not joint, independence of interior descents from marked cycle length. It is exact for uniform one-line permutations with n>=3. Historical priority remains provisional: classical conjugacy-class/descent enumerations could hide a marked-cycle refinement. The day-level date is that of the first available verified-date primary preprint used (Fulman 1997-12-09); older relevant works exist with bibliographic year or month only and are explicitly identified in RESULT.md. No independent validation has occurred.
title: One-site localization of marked-cycle-length dependence in permutation descents
